title: OFSCP DM Message Create Request (v0.1)
description: Body of POST /api/federation/dms/{dmId}/messages (§8.3): a single DM delivered by the sender's client to the recipient's home provider. The provider MUST reject the request when {dmId} does not equal the id derived from {sender, recipient} (§7.4).

clientMessageId.description: Client-chosen idempotency key. Providers MUST treat (author, dmId, clientMessageId) as idempotent (§7.1).
